name: Total Intake Events
description: The total count of Record Received events processed. WHY 'count' and no filters: aggregation 'count' (contracts v1.5) accepts recordType/timeWindow/illustrative only — it is the one aggregation kind that cannot filter, so it is demonstrated here as a plain total rather than a subset.

name: Open Intake Cases
description: The count of Intake Cases that are not yet in a terminal (closed) workflow state.

name: Cases by Severity
description: The distribution of open Intake Cases grouped by severity level.

name: Repeated Record Signal Trend
description: The count of repeated-record-intake Signals raised per week, used to visualise recurrence trends.

name: Follow-Up Actions At Risk
description: The count of open or in-progress follow-up Actions due, or at risk of missing their due date, within 24 hours.
